purpose: Curated classifications that cannot be inferred safely from the generated variable inventory or Earth Engine audit.

classification.label: Continuing collection
classification.meaning: The provider adds dated observations. UzGeoData can fetch missing periods and append a versioned result after quality checks.

classification.label: Versioned release
classification.meaning: The provider publishes a fixed edition. Updates mean reviewing and importing a new edition, not polling for another month.

classification.label: Fixed reference
classification.meaning: A climatology, geometry or historical snapshot whose date is part of its scientific definition.

classification.label: Local snapshot
classification.meaning: The public record stops at the last supplied local file. Extending it requires a new delivery and a controlled append.

classification.label: Derived product
classification.meaning: UzGeoData recomputes this output after one or more upstream inputs pass validation.

local_snapshots.title: Pskem, Oygaing and Tashkent station workbooks
local_snapshots.update_policy: Append a newly supplied workbook only after schema, duplicate, missing-month and station-metadata checks.

local_snapshots.title: Chirchik–Charvak case-study remote inputs
local_snapshots.provider: Earth Engine extraction saved for the case study
local_snapshots.update_policy: Extend the extraction window as a new case-study run; do not silently change the evidence used by the published analysis.

external_sources.title: CA-discharge: Geo-Located Discharge Time Series for Mountainous Rivers in Central Asia
external_sources.coverage: Downloaded v1.0 package: 297 gauge rows; 136 with time-series flags; 244,632 observations from 1910-01-25 to 2021-06-25. The paper reports 295 locations and 135 series.
external_sources.state: integrated research index — source GeoPackage held locally
external_sources.update_policy: Review Zenodo metadata for a new version; checksum-pin and re-import each approved release without overwriting the prior research snapshot.
external_sources.storage_note: The 24.6 MB GeoPackage is held outside the website artifact. The 11.8 GB raw-data archive and 228 MB scripts archive are not mirrored; compact derived evidence and checksums are public.
